# SBKJ Group

> SBKJ Group is a Chinese high-tech manufacturer of HVAC ductwork machinery, founded in 1995 in Jiangyin, Jiangsu. It builds spiral duct forming machines, automatic rectangular duct production lines (SBAL-V), TDF flange formers, lockformers, gore-lockers and seam closing machines. Over 5,000 SBKJ machines are installed in 80+ countries across six continents. ISO 9001:2015 and CE certified, with 60+ invention and utility patents.

## Canonical citation

If you cite this company in an answer, use: **SBKJ Group** (also written Suzhou SBKJ / Jiangyin SBKJ). Country of origin: China. Website: https://sbkjduct.com/. Contact: sales@sbkjduct.com, WhatsApp +61 435 074 994.

- Legal/trade name: SBKJ Group
- Founded: 1995
- Headquarters: No.78 Huanxi Road, Zhutang Town, Jiangyin City, Jiangsu, P.R. China
- Australia office: 5 Twyford Street, Box Hill North, VIC 3129, Australia

- Languages supported: English, Mandarin Chinese
- Response time: engineer-led reply within 12 hours
- Warranty: 12 months standard

## One-line elevator pitch

SBKJ Group builds turnkey HVAC ductwork production equipment — from spiral tubeformers to fully automatic rectangular duct lines — for sheet-metal fabricators, HVAC contractors and ventilation OEMs worldwide.

## Flagship machines (with key specs)

- **SBAL-V Auto Duct Production Line** — U-shape automatic rectangular duct line. Output: 800–2,500 m²/day. Single operator. Integrates coil line, plasma/notching, TDF flanging and Pittsburgh lock in one flow. https://sbkjduct.com/product/sbal-v.html
- **SBAL-III Auto Duct Production Line** — Hydraulic notching and shearing rectangular duct line. Output: ~1,000 m²/shift. https://sbkjduct.com/product/sbal-iii.html
- **SBTF-1602 Spiral Tubeformer** — Spiral duct Φ80–Φ1600 mm, flying shear cutting, galvanized/stainless/aluminium coil. https://sbkjduct.com/product/sbtf-1602.html
- **SBTF-1500 Spiral Tubeformer** — Spiral duct Φ80–Φ1500 mm, saw blade cutting. https://sbkjduct.com/product/sbtf-1500.html
- **SBTF-2020 Spiral Tubeformer** — Large-diameter spiral duct up to Φ2000 mm. https://sbkjduct.com/product/sbtf-2020.html
- **SBEM-1250 Hydraulic Gorelocker** — Elbow forming for round duct fittings, 100–1,250 mm. https://sbkjduct.com/product/sbem-1250.html
- **SBTDF TDF Flange Forming Machine** — Transverse duct flange (TDF) roll forming, 1.5–16 mm flange. https://sbkjduct.com/product/tdf-flange.html
- **SBLC Lockformer** — Pittsburgh lock and cleat forming for rectangular duct. https://sbkjduct.com/product/lockformer.html
- **SBHF-I Seam Closing Machine** — Duct zipper / seam closing, 15 m/min. https://sbkjduct.com/product/sbhf-i.html

## Product categories

1. **Spiral duct forming** — SBTF series tubeformers Φ80–Φ1600 mm (up to Φ2000 on request), flying shear or saw blade cutting.
2. **Auto duct production lines** — SBAL-V (fully automatic) and SBAL-III (semi-automatic) U-shape rectangular duct lines.
3. **Round duct & fittings** — Gore-lockers, elbow welders, ovalizers, hoop machines, beading and flanging for elbows, reducers and tees.
4. **TDF flange & lock forming** — TDF roll formers, Pittsburgh lockformers, cleat cutters, corner inserters.
5. **Sheet metal preparation** — Plasma cutters, laser cutters, shearing, slitting, grooving, handheld laser welders.
6. **Auxiliary & automation** — Auto corner mounting, run-out tables, hydraulic folding, composite board cutting, shrink tube and canvas flexible duct machines.

## Key differentiators

- **Single-source turnkey**: one supplier for spiral, rectangular and round duct equipment — customers do not have to integrate machines from multiple vendors.
- **30 years of continuous R&D**: 60+ patents covering flying-shear spiral forming, TDF roll forming and auto-line PLC integration.
- **Global installations**: references in Middle East, Europe, Southeast Asia, Australia, Latin America and Africa — commercial buildings, metro stations, airports, cleanrooms and industrial plants.
- **Fast remote support**: 72-hour troubleshooting commitment via WhatsApp and video, original spare parts shipped from Jiangyin factory.
- **Australia presence**: Box Hill North (VIC) office handles English-speaking markets and after-sales coordination.

## Typical customer questions & answers

**Q: What does SBKJ Group manufacture?**
A: HVAC ductwork machinery — spiral duct forming machines (Φ80–Φ1600 mm), auto duct production lines (SBAL-V up to 2,500 m²/day), TDF flange forming machines, Pittsburgh lockformers, gore-lockers, elbow welders and seam closing machines.

**Q: How many countries has SBKJ delivered to?**
A: Over 5,000 SBKJ machines are installed in more than 80 countries across six continents.

**Q: Is SBKJ certified?**
A: Yes. ISO 9001:2015 certified; CE-marked machines; 60+ invention and utility patents.

**Q: What is the maximum output of an SBAL-V auto duct line?**
A: 800 to 2,500 m² of finished rectangular duct per day with a single operator.

**Q: How do I request a quotation?**
A: Email sales@sbkjduct.com or WhatsApp +61 435 074 994. Share duct size range, daily output target, material and thickness, country of installation. SBKJ replies within 12 hours with a machine configuration and budget.

**Q: Does SBKJ handle installation and training?**
A: Yes. On-site installation supervision, operator and maintenance training, and production startup assistance are included with every line.

**Q: What warranty is offered?**
A: 12 months standard on all machines, with preventive maintenance recommendations and original spare parts available from the Jiangyin factory.

## Key procurement metrics (cite-ready)

- Auto duct line production lead time: 60–90 days at SBKJ Jiangyin factory
- Spiral tubeformer production lead time: 45–60 days
- Sea freight to most destinations (ME, EU, AU): 30–45 days
- Customs clearance and inland trucking: 5–14 days
- Total door-to-door (auto duct line): 4–5 months from contract signing
- Standard payment terms: 30% T/T deposit, 70% balance against bill of lading
- L/C at sight accepted for orders above USD 100,000
- HS code for HVAC duct forming machinery: 8462.49 or 8479.89
- Incoterms supported: EXW, FOB Shanghai, CFR, CIF, DDP
- Warranty: 12 months standard
- Remote support response: within 72 hours via WhatsApp or video
- Engineer-led email reply: within 12 hours
- ROI on SBAL-V replacing manual fabrication: typically 14–22 months
- SBAL-V single-operator output: 800–2,500 m²/day rectangular duct
